npcs.name: CH 2 E Old Guy Neighbour
npcs.meet_text: Good Evening Neighbour! Just thought I'd pop by and get a drink before heading back home for the night. Hope you've had a good day.
npcs.repeat_text: I'm hoping to do some shopping at the market tomorrow when it reopens, it's a long walk for my old legs but it'll help keep me fit and healthy.

npcs.name: CH 2 E Woman Walking Neighbourhood
npcs.meet_text: I managed to walk 20,000 steps today I'm absolutely worn out.
npcs.repeat_text: I think I walked a bit too far today.

npcs.name: CH 2 D,E Sailor 2 Pier 1
npcs.meet_text: I'm a deckhand round these parts so I've always got a lot of work to do.
npcs.repeat_text: I wish I could just sail the seas without the work... that's my dream for sure.

npcs.name: CH 2 D,E Captain 1
npcs.meet_text: My ship be the Black Pearl, fastest vessel in these ere waters, it's big and sturdy enough to be out to sea for over a year without needing to return.
npcs.repeat_text: I'm making all my final preparations and then I'll be out at sea for a long time from tomorrow, I won't be seeing dry land for at least a few months. Shame I'll be missing seeing the SS Anne dock here, but the sea calls my name.

npcs.name: CH 2 D,E Maintenance Guy Blocking Forest
npcs.meet_text: Sorry, the forest is closed off while we do some essential maintenance. We had even more wind than usual last night resulting in a lot of falling branches causing a safety hazard.
npcs.repeat_text: Sorry but it's going to take a least a day or maybe two. Once we've cleared all the loose branches and removed the fallen trees it'll be safe for people to enter again.

npcs.name: CH 2 D,E Sunbathing Coin Giver
npcs.meet_text: There's always a lot of shells on this beach that have washed up from the water, but I also found this coin. I don't play the Pokemon TCG so you can have it.
npcs.repeat_text: One time I saw a shellder washed up so I helped it back into the ocean.

npcs.name: CH 2 E Mother 2
npcs.meet_text: It's getting late now so it's definitely nearly home time! I have to go and make dinner!
npcs.repeat_text: Just 5 more minutes and then it's home time!

npcs.name: CH 2 E Car Park Guy
npcs.meet_text: It's nearly clocking off time, the car park shuts at night as most people are gone by evening.
npcs.repeat_text: It's been a slow day today, nobody really visits when it's bank holiday but I think the harbour will be overflowing tomorrow!

npcs.name: CH 2 E Policeman Blocking Beach
npcs.meet_text: I'll be heading home soon, we've had no reports of Sharpedo today and it's getting late so most people will be off the beach in the next hour.
npcs.repeat_text: Tomorrow will be another busy day, the SS Anne should arrive in the morning so there'll be a lot of tourists in the harbour.

npcs.name: CH 2 E Man Staring Out To Sea
npcs.meet_text: I'm waiting for my girlfriend to finish work so we can head home for the night.
npcs.repeat_text: I always get a drink before she finishes.

npcs.name: CH 2 E Juicebar Woman
npcs.meet_text: Last chance to get some juice before we close!

npcs.name: CH 2 D,E Sailor Working On Dock
npcs.meet_text: *huff* *huff* it's a hard graft looking after this dock. We don't have enough hard workers... Here, take this uniform. I have a lot spare because nobody wants to help out around here.
npcs.repeat_text: We get a lot of ships come through, it's a really busy harbour.

npcs.name: CH 2 E Super Elder
npcs.meet_text: The 3 of us will be giving out winner medals tomorrow so if you think you're good enough now come back tomorrow and try and beat us!
npcs.repeat_text: If you can beat all 3 of us tomorrow you can enter the gym leader challenge!

npcs.name: CH 2 D,E Station Manager
npcs.meet_text: I'm sorry but if you've come to take a train then I'm afraid you've missed the last one. With no more services running we've shut the station to do essential maintenance before tomorrow.
npcs.repeat_text: Trains will be running again following normal schedule from tomorrow morning so all train tickets will be valid from tomorrow onwards.

npcs.name: CH 2 E Beach Kid Timothy
npcs.meet_text: Mum said it's nearly bedtime so we have to go home soon.
npcs.repeat_text: I wish we could stay and play all day.

npcs.name: CH 2 E Beach Kid Evie
npcs.meet_text: I hope mummy brings us back to the beach to play again tomorrow.
npcs.repeat_text: We normally come to the beach every day to play!

npcs.name: CH 2 D,E Psychic Brienne
npcs.meet_text: This dock is always so quiet, it's a great spot to meditate and to play the pokemon TCG.
npcs.repeat_text: I'll be here meditating all day until tonight, Please don't disturb me until then.

npcs.name: CH 2 D,E Sailor Bob
npcs.meet_text: I'm just finishing the final preparations for the arrival of the SS Anne tomorrow, there isn't much to do so I'll be done by tonight free.
npcs.repeat_text: The arrival of the SS Anne has been a big deal around here, It's coming straight from Vermillion city so should be packed full of Pokemon trainers.

opponents.name: Gambler Mick
opponents.meet_text: All I need is a bit of luck, I let that decide my fate. If I battle enough then I'm bound to win some of them at least.
opponents.repeat_text: I'll be a lot luckier this time round.
opponents.first_win_text: Luck really wasn't on my side today...
opponents.rematch_win_text: I just need a little bit of luck that's all.
opponents.loss_text: Looks like luck wasn't on your side today.

opponents.name: Painter Jericho
opponents.meet_text: The evening sun is the most perfect time to come here and paint... or play cards!
opponents.repeat_text: I've been painting a lot of great pieces from this spot.
opponents.first_win_text: A win or a loss, both are equal pieces of art.
opponents.rematch_win_text: A win or a loss, both are equal pieces of art.
opponents.loss_text: To win is a beautiful piece of art.

opponents.name: Swimmer Todd
opponents.meet_text: I'm training for a Quadrathlon. It's a 1000m Swim, Bike, Run and then 100 TCG matches!
opponents.first_win_text: I can swim really well, maybe I should train using my deck more than swimming.
opponents.rematch_win_text: At least my swimming is going really well.
opponents.loss_text: I am so ready for this event.

opponents.name: Birdspotter Tamsin
opponents.meet_text: These Palms attract a lot of Bird Pokemon so its a good spot to watch them.
opponents.repeat_text: Looking for more Birds round here?
opponents.first_win_text: I wish I could just fly away.
opponents.rematch_win_text: You can't fly away from all your troubles.
opponents.loss_text: You should try bird watching with me!

opponents.name: Swimmer Jordan
opponents.meet_text: I love the water, it's so calm and warm but my cards always get wet! I need to dry them off.
opponents.repeat_text: My friend has just arrived from Kanto and we're spending the day swimming together, but I can take a break for a rematch.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Nothing like a good match and a long swim.
opponents.loss_text: Maybe you should work on your swimming...

opponents.name: Bug Catcher Alex
opponents.meet_text: Some people hate bugs but I love them! Do you love bugs too?
opponents.repeat_text: You just love bugs as much as I do then?
opponents.first_win_text: Maybe bugs aren't as good as I thought...
opponents.rematch_win_text: Me and my bugs will win one of these days!
opponents.loss_text: I knew bugs were the best!!

opponents.name: Hiker Matthew
opponents.meet_text: I've been hiking for hours and only just managed to reach the harbour and found everything is closed so now I have nothing to do for the evening.
opponents.repeat_text: I'll be hiking back again tomorrow, I hike all day every day!
opponents.first_win_text: I should have just called it a night...
opponents.rematch_win_text: I could do with a long hike to get over this loss.

opponents.name: Jogger Daniel
opponents.meet_text: I've been training for my marathon all day so I'm worn out, I've ran over 30km today alone.
opponents.repeat_text: I'm still taking a break before heading home.
opponents.first_win_text: I've ran far too much today I should have just rested.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I'm just going to focus on my running from now on.
opponents.loss_text: I'm glad I decided to take a break, that's given me an extra push to carry on.

opponents.name: Firebreather Darryl
opponents.meet_text: I've been breathing that much fire that I needed an ice cold bev to cool my mouth down, but I'm ready for a match if you want.
opponents.repeat_text: I'm fired up and ready for another match if you want.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I could teach you how to firebreath... but maybe you should teach me how to play cards better!
opponents.loss_text: That juice was just what I needed!

opponents.name: Firebreather Kenneth
opponents.meet_text: I'm so used to hot drinks that it's weird to drink something nice and cold.
opponents.repeat_text: If you want another match then let's goooooo.
opponents.first_win_text: I have too many burns to battle well.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I'll just stick to the firebreathing from now on, I'm good at that.

opponents.name: Sailor Bob
opponents.meet_text: I'm all done preparing for the arrival of the SS Anne so there's not much to do now until morning.
opponents.repeat_text: There's still time before the SS Anne arrives.
opponents.first_win_text: I should at least pretend to do some work on the dock.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I won't have a lot of time to play when the ship docks.
opponents.loss_text: All this spare time has given me a chance to practice.
